GOOD TO KNOW

Frequently Asked Questions

Are your gemstones and rudraksha certified?

Yes. Every gemstone ships with a verifiable lab certificate from GIA, IGI, GRS or a Govt.-accredited lab, and every rudraksha is X-ray tested for authenticity.

Do you offer Cash on Delivery?

Yes, COD is available across India. Paying online on orders of ₹1,499+ unlocks an extra 5% off and a free 5-Mukhi Rudraksha at checkout.

How do I know which gemstone is right for me?

Take the free gem quiz above for a quick rashi-based suggestion, or book a consultation with our astrologers for a full birth-chart reading.

What is energization and is it included?

Energization (pran-pratishtha) is a Vedic ritual performed by our pandits before dispatch, activating the stone with traditional mantras.

How fast is delivery?

Orders are dispatched within 48 hours and typically delivered in 3–7 business days across India.

Natural Certified Gemstones & Rudraksha Online

GemsMantra by Astro Arun Pandit offers 100% natural, lab-certified gemstones — Yellow Sapphire (Pukhraj), Emerald (Panna), Blue Sapphire (Neelam), Ruby (Manik), Pearl (Moti) and the full Navratna — alongside original 1 to 21 Mukhi Rudraksha, energized bracelets, malas and yantras. Every piece is astrology-matched, energized and shipped with a verifiable certificate.
